title: Nephilim Resurrection
description:
Nephilim Resurrection is a thrilling retro-style first-person shooter that immerses players in an ancient Mesopotamian steampunk world. Set against the backdrop of an alternate ancient civilization, the game seamlessly blends historical aesthetics with futuristic steam-powered technology. As a lone survivor, you’ll navigate a perilous ancient world, safeguarding your most precious cargo; and the weight of this unspoken burden rests upon your shoulders.

Frenetic Boomer Shooter Action: Engage in classic boomer shooter game play, where adrenaline-fueled combat meets cerebral puzzles and strategic encounters.

Thundering Heavy Metal Soundtrack: The pulse-pounding retro-meets-progressive-heavy metal-inspired soundtrack, underpins your harrowing journey. Find us on Spotify!

Shape Your Destiny: Act swiftly to determine the fate the protagonist and their prize in a world teetering on the edge of transformation and ruin.

• First-Person Perspective: Experience the action from a first-person viewpoint.

• Single-Player Focus: Tailored for solo play, the game emphasizes PvE encounters.

• Meticulously Designed Levels: Navigate through intricately crafted environments, each filled with challenges and combat sequences against waves of enemies and challenging bosses with puzzle platforming elements.

• Diverse Arsenal: Choose from many unlockable, powerful weapons; each offering a distinct playstyle. Adapt your strategy to overcome adversaries. 

• Unlock Special Abilities: Breathe underwater, manipulate time, and execute gravity-defying double jumps.

• Created by an independent company Arrogant Pixel. 100% self-published and self-funded.

• Music and Sound Design is a big focus in our games, and we've got another full soundtrack composed by AssadB and our in-house metal band "NEPHILLIM RESURRECTION"
description_short: Embark on a furious journey, protecting precious cargo in a perilous world. Boomer shooter mechanics blend with puzzles and strategic encounters. Engage in PvE action, solve puzzles, and battle foes to a heavy metal soundtrack, immersing you in the adrenaline-fueled atmosphere.
